title: STASH VALUE AND BAG VALUE IN THE TOP RIGHT
why: His order: "Stash value and bag value are always shown in the top right corner, everywhere, with credits and XP." The corner readout kept credits and XP only. It now carries a small second line, STASH and BAG, on the Undercroft floor and in a raid.
now: The top right corner now also shows STASH and BAG values under credits and XP.

edits.replacement: var c=(P.credits||0).toLocaleString(), x=(P.xp||0).toLocaleString(), sv=trStash(), bv=trBag(), s=c+'|'+x+'|'+sv+'|'+bv;   // v28.xx (cw-stashbag)

edits.anchor: el.innerHTML=c+' <small>CREDITS</small> '+x+' <small>XP</small>';   // spaces, so the text reads right when copied
edits.replacement: el.innerHTML=c+' CREDITS '+x+' XP STASH '+sv.toLocaleString()+' BAG '+bv.toLocaleString()+''; // v28.xx (cw-stashbag): spaces, so the text reads right when copied

try{ return (el.getBoundingClientRect().bottom||0)+Math.round(18*(parseFloat(el.style.zoom)||1)); }catch(_e){ return 0; }   // v28.xx (cw-stashbag): the STASH and BAG line hangs 18 below the readout box

#topright small:nth-last-child(2){ margin-right:0; }   /* v28.xx (cw-stashbag): the STASH and BAG line is the last child now */
  #topright .trsub{ position:absolute; right:0; top:40px; line-height:16px; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; color:var(--ash); }
